{{Quote|It's said that if the return to Cuipernam of certain offworld visitors could be delayed for two parts of a breeding cycle, a great reward would be paid.|Baiuntu, to the Jedi and their companions|<ref name="The Approaching Storm" />}}
In [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]], during a [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] [[Border dispute on Ansion/Legends|diplomatic mission]] to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Ansion/Legends|Ansion]], a '''skirmish''' occurred in a [[Qulun camp|camp]] belonging to the nomadic [[Qulun]] clan. Four [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]]&mdash;[[Jedi Master/Legends|Masters]] [[Luminara Unduli/Legends|Luminara Unduli]] and [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]], and their respective [[Padawan/Legends|Padawans]], [[Barriss Offee/Legends|Barriss Offee]] and [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]]&mdash;were [[Border dispute on Ansion/Legends|dispatched]] to Ansion to prevent its [[Separatist Crisis/Legends|secession]] from the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]]. However, they were [[Spice/Legends|drugged]] by the Qulun chieftain [[Baiuntu]] and taken captive alongside the clanless [[Ansionian]]s [[Kyakhta]] and [[Bulgan]] in an attempt to stop them from completing their mission, as [[Soergg Vosadii Bezhin|Soergg the Hutt]] promised a reward to those who delayed the offworlders' return to [[Cuipernam]], the planet's [[Capital/Legends|capital]] [[City/Legends|city]], until after the vote for secession had taken place. The [[Prisoner/Legends|captives]] were soon freed by the [[Gwurran]] [[Tooqui]], and the group promptly escaped the camp.

==Prelude==
{{Quote|Welcome, offworlders! The Qulun bid you welcome!|Baiuntu, to the Jedi and their companions|<ref name="The Approaching Storm" />}}
During the [[Separatist Crisis/Legends|Separatist Crisis]] in [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]], in which many [[Star system/Legends|star systems]] seceded from the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] to form the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]], the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Ansion/Legends|Ansion]] became a target in a plot led by [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Dooku/Legends|Darth Tyranus]] and [[Commerce Guild/Legends|Commerce Guild]] [[Presidente]] [[Shu Mai/Legends|Shu Mai]], to have it secede from the Republic.

Ansion lay at the heart of several treaties, meaning that if it seceded, many other worlds would have to follow. The [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] dispatched four of its members&mdash;[[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Masters]] [[Luminara Unduli/Legends|Luminara Unduli]] and [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]], along with their respective [[Padawan/Legends|Padawans]], [[Barriss Offee/Legends|Barriss Offee]] and [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]]&mdash;on a [[Border dispute on Ansion/Legends|diplomatic mission]] to Ansion to reach an agreement with the [[Unity of Community]], Ansion's government. The [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] hoped to negotiate an arrangement between the Unity of Community and the [[Alwari]], the [[Ansionian]] nomadic tribes of the Ansion plains, to end the protracted conflict between the two dominant groups. To that end, the Jedi sought out the [[Borokii]], the most powerful [[overclan]] of the Alwari, and they were [[Kidnapping of Barriss Offee|joined]] in this endeavor by [[Kyakhta]] and [[Bulgan]], two clanless Ansionian males.<ref name="The Approaching Storm" />

It was shortly after [[Tooqui]], a male [[Gwurran]], joined their group, that the Jedi and their companions encountered a patrol of the [[Qulun]], a non-traditional Alwari clan that was essentially a trading faction. [[Baiuntu]], the clan's chief [[Merchant/Legends|trader]], invited the Jedi to join him in the [[Qulun camp]]. After Baiuntu showed them the Qulun's varied artware and allowed them to sample fragrant essences which they sold, the Jedi and their two Ansionian companions were [[Spice/Legends|drugged]]. [[Paluruvu]], an extract containing a powerful sedative, was the deceptive catalyst that the chief trader employed to sedate both himself and his guests.

When the Jedi and their Ansionian companions awoke, Baiuntu informed them that they were being held because of a large reward promised by [[Bossban]] [[Soergg Vosadii Bezhin|Soergg]] to those who could delay the group's return to Cuipernam until after the vote for secession had taken place. He also told them that he had destroyed their [[Comlink/Legends|comlinks]] in order to keep them from informing anyone in Cuipernam of their progress with the Alwari tribes. Tooqui, however, had evaded capture, as he was not with the group at the [[Time/Legends|time]] they were drugged. As such, he was able to shortly thereafter return to the camp and free his companions.<ref name="The Approaching Storm" />

==The skirmish==
{{Quote|Tooqui tell truth. Tooqui bravest of his people. The strongest, the fiercest, the wisest&mdash;|Tooqui, as he frees his companions|<ref name="The Approaching Storm" />}}
Tooqui, having escaped the Qulun camp, agitated a local herd of native [[lorqual]] by throwing rocks at them, causing them to stampede toward the camp. Though some of the animals were stopped by [[Sentry droid/Legends|sentries]], the rest reached the camp. While the Qulun were distracted by the stampeding lorqual, Tooqui sneaked into the [[Transport/Legends|transport]] where the Jedi and their companions were being held and freed them using a [[Knife/Legends|knife]] belonging to Bulgan. After being freed, the Jedi engaged four nearby sentries, quickly [[Death/Legends|killing]] them before leaving the camp to continue the search for the Borokii overclan.<ref name="The Approaching Storm" />

==Aftermath==
{{Quote|You idiots! Gather yourselves. Collect your wits!|Baiuntu, attempting to organize a pursuit of the Jedi|<ref name="The Approaching Storm" />}}
While attempting to organize a pursuit of the group, Baiuntu was killed by a pack of [[shanh]]s, predatory animals native to Ansion. Shortly after escaping, the Jedi and their companions found the ruling Borokii and fought in a [[Skirmish between the Borokii and the Januul|skirmish]] between the Borokii and the [[Januul]], who were overclan rivals and traditional enemies.<ref name="The Approaching Storm" />

==Behind the scenes==
The skirmish in the Qulun camp first appeared in the [[2002]] novel ''[[The Approaching Storm]]'', written by [[Alan Dean Foster]].<ref name="The Approaching Storm" />
